title: Umuhanuzi w'imisozi yashushanyijwe
intro: Mu butayu bukabije bwo muri Arabiya ya kera, havutse umuntu mu bantu bazwiho ubuhanga budasanzwe. Inzu zabo zavuye ku rutare rukomeye, nyamara imitima yabo yari ikomeye kurusha imisozi bacukuye. Intumwa y'Imana yaje ifite ikimenyetso kimwe cy'igitangaza - ariko ubwibone n'ubugome byazanye ingaruka zihuse kandi ziteye ubwoba. Ese ushobora kumenya umugaragu w'icyubahiro abantu be bahisemo kurimbuka kuruta ubuyobozi?
clues: Natumwe kuba umuburira ku bantu banjye, mbahamagarira gusenga Imana Imwe Rukumbi.
Abantu banjye babaga mu mabuye akomeye, bashushanya amazu meza cyane mu misozi.
Ingamiya y'ingore y'igitangaza yavuye mu rutare rukomeye ubwo nasengaga, ikimenyetso gisobanutse neza kivuye ku Mushoborabyose.
Nabwiye abantu banjye gusangira amazi n'iyi ngamiya y'ingore kandi ntibayagire icyo bayangiza.
Abantu banjye bagambiriye kurwanya ingamiya y'ingore bayica amaguru, bayitsemba ubwabo.
Umutingito uteye ubwoba wibasiye abantu banjye, basigara baguye mu mazu yabo.

trial.label: Ni ikihe kibazo cyagenwe?
options: Gukubitwa kw'ingamiya y'ingore mu buryo bw'igitangaza
trial.answer: Gukubitwa kw'ingamiya y'ingore mu buryo bw'igitangaza

outcome.label: Ni iyihe iherezo ryabo rya nyuma?

arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَثَمُودُ
verse: And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and ʿAad and Thamūd deny [their prophets], (22:42)
